title: The notifications inbox: choose its shape
question: On the phone, from the bell. You chose: things waiting for you first, then what the church sent. Lock one, steer it, or ask for another hand.

options.label: Waiting and Everything
options.thesis: A segmented switch under the masthead: Waiting opens first when anything waits, Everything holds the rest.
options.viewport: Masthead with '2 waiting for you · 3 new', the Waiting | Everything switch with an orange count, rows with a deep-aqua 'Open the draft' link.
options.risk: Most members never have anything waiting, so for them the switch is a control with nothing behind one side; it should hide when Waiting is empty.

options.label: The noticeboard
options.thesis: Each notice shows its whole message, as on the church noticeboard; anything waiting is a pinned sand card with its action.
options.viewport: A pinned 'Waiting for you' callout with a button, then notices with title, time and the full message in reading type.
options.risk: Long messages make a long page; a busy week of notices needs more scrolling than a list.

options.label: Bulletin sections
options.thesis: Two bulletin sections: Waiting for you, then From the church by day (Today, Earlier), one line each.
options.viewport: Section 'Waiting for you' with warm tiles; section 'From the church' with Mark all read, grouped Today and Earlier, unread dots.
options.risk: Messages are cut to one line, so the full text means a tap into what it opens.
